Then he walked inside, found a pen, and began composing a reply he might never be able to send.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市陷入一种奇异的寂静。路灯仍亮着，橙黄色的光洒在空旷的柏油路上，像是为无人观赏的舞台打下最后一束追光。远处传来一辆环卫车低沉的轰鸣，打破了夜与晨之间脆弱的平衡。便利店的灯光从玻璃门溢出，店员倚在柜台边打着瞌睡。一只流浪猫沿着墙根无声地走过，偶尔停下来嗅一嗅潮湿的空气。天边尚未泛白，城市像一个翻了个身却还没醒来的人，呼吸均匀而悠长，等待着第一缕晨光将它彻底唤醒。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem, like looking up a word in a dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a 'base case' — a point where it stops calling itself and just gives a direct answer, like finally finding a word you already know.\n• So the function keeps breaking the job into tinier pieces, solves the tiniest piece on its own, and then builds the full answer back up from all those small answers."}
